 CBSE Board Exam Dates 2027: Steps to download date sheet
 When CBSE releases the Class 10 and Class 12 timetable, students can follow these steps to download the CBSE exam timetable PDF.
 Visit the official CBSE website, cbse.gov.in
 On the homepage, find the latest announcements section
 Click on the link for ‘CBSE Class 10 or Class 12 date sheet 2027’
 The examination timetable PDF will display on the screen
 Download the date sheet and save it for future reference
 Students should check the subject-wise exam dates and timings while preparing for the board examinations

 CBSE Board Exam 2027: Private candidate registration, LOC deadline
 The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has opened the application process for private candidates who are appearing for the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations 2027. Candidates can submit their applications and pay the required fees until October 23, 2026.
 Meanwhile, CBSE will also close the List of Candidates (LOC) submission process for regular students. Schools that fail to submit the details within the deadline can complete the process between October 22 and October 30 by paying a late fee of Rs 2,000 per candidate.
 Schools can also make corrections to candidates' names, parents' or guardians' names, and dates of birth from November 2 to November 4, 2026.
